facets.notes: Single output port 'output'; tile-major + zero-padded so downstream AdaptiveBitpack(block_size=tile_elems) packs one block per tile. 1-D is intentionally out of scope — covered by LorenzoStage::setBlockSize. graph-capturable = forward/compress path only (capture is forward-only in this library).

provenance.algorithm_origin: cuSZp3 / VGC (SC'25) dimension-aware tiled separable delta

papers.title: GPU Lossy Compression for HPC Can Be Versatile and Ultra-Fast
papers.authors: Yafan Huang, Sheng Di, Guanpeng Li, Franck Cappello
papers.note: cuSZp3 / VGC — source of the dimension-aware tiled separable delta

summary.one_liner: cuSZp3 dimension-aware tiled separable integer delta predictor (2D/3D), lossless.
features: 2D/3D separable integer Lorenzo within fixed tiles
Tile-major, zero-padded output feeds AdaptiveBitpack one block per tile (cuSZp3 layout)
Forward (compress) path is CUDA-graph capturable (deterministic sizes, no D2H); capture is forward-only
Inverse un-tiles back to natural row-major order
